title: mavai-R conformance case suite
description: Schema for statistical conformance reference datasets produced by mavai-R, fixture schema version 2. Each JSON file represents one suite of test cases. Top-level shape is uniform across suites; the inputs/expected payloads vary per suite. See R/*.R generators for the per-suite payload shape. Version 2 (methodology 1.5.0) adds methodologyVersion, fixtureSchemaVersion and decisionRules at suite level and an optional decisionRule per case.

methodologyVersion.description: The Statistical Companion methodology version the suite's expected values implement (e.g. '1.5.0').

fixtureSchemaVersion.description: Version of the fixture file shape this schema describes. 1 was the unversioned shape up to fixtures 0.10.13; 2 adds methodologyVersion, fixtureSchemaVersion and decisionRules.

decisionRules.description: The versioned decision rules the suite's expected values depend on; empty for descriptive and structural suites.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this suite tests.

method.description: Statistical method used to produce expected values.

tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance for floating-point comparison of expected values. A tolerance of 0 means exact match is required.

cases.description: The individual test cases in this suite.

name.description: Unique, descriptive case identifier within this suite.

description.description: Optional per-case description, used in suites where individual cases warrant prose explanation.

approach.description: Sub-approach within the suite (e.g. 'sample_size_first', 'threshold_first'). Present only in suites with multiple derivation strategies.

procedure.description: Procedure direction per companion §3.2 / §1.4.6 (SC-RU-05): the kind of threshold, not a versioned rule (see decisionRule). Present on inferential per-criterion cases.

decisionRule.description: The decision rule(s) a case exercises, where its suite lists more than one. A configuration carrying both a normative and an empirical bar names both.

inputs.description: Input parameters for the statistical computation. Shape varies by suite. Computation suites use a flat numeric-keyed object; per-criterion verdict suites add a procedure string; baseline-object and scenario suites carry nested baseline / test_run objects.

expected.description: Expected outputs from R's reference computation. Shape varies by suite. Numeric values are compared within the suite's tolerance; boolean / string values are compared exactly; nested objects are compared structurally.

decisionRuleId.description: A versioned decision rule: the four of methodology 1.5.0, and the two SMOKE rules of methodology 1.7.0 (1.7.1 states that their criteria enter neither Type-I envelope).

anyJson.description: Any JSON value: number, boolean, string, null, array, or object. Used where the schema cannot tightly constrain the shape because it varies per suite.
